## Checklist
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (and the C++ tests if `native/` changed)
- [ ] New models cite a reference and include a validation test
- [ ] No market data is invented; failures raise errors
- [ ] No API keys, secrets or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Docs / Guide / CHANGELOG updated if user-facing
